title: Collaboration partners
intro: Organisations that {inst} co-published with, matched on ROR identifiers. Filter by faculty, country, sector, topic, funder or open access status, and open any partner for full faculty, researcher, journal and publication breakdowns.

years.range: Showing works published from {from} to {to} (controlled by the year selector in the top bar).

search.placeholder: Search by name, acronym (e.g. TU Delft, UMCG, MST) or city
search.aria: Search partners by name, acronym, alias or city

modes.sizeStandardHint: Excludes mega-consortia (>20 partner organisations per work) so strategic collaborations stand out.
modes.sizeSmallHint: Bilateral and small-team works with at most 5 partner organisations.
modes.sizeAllHint: Includes large multi-centre and global consortium publications.
modes.rollupHint: Combines same-city hospital locations, embedded university institutes, and inactive ROR successors under one organisation while keeping distinct universities separate.

activeFilters.label: Active filters
activeFilters.detailNotice: This partner view is narrowed by filters from the partners overview.
activeFilters.showAll: Show all {inst} works with this partner

map.title: Where the partners are
map.description: Map of the partner organisations. Each circle is one partner in the colour of its organisation type, and a larger circle marks more shared works. A numbered circle groups the partners of one area. The table below lists the same partners.
map.point: {works, plural, one {# shared work} other {# shared works}}
map.group: {count, plural, one {# partner} other {# partners}} in this area
map.groupHint: Select to zoom in, or to list partners that share one place.
map.listTitle: {count, plural, one {# partner} other {# partners}} at this place
map.inView: {count, plural, =0 {No partners in view} one {# partner in view} other {# partners in view}}
map.legend: Partners in view per organisation type (select to filter)
map.legendHint: Click a type to toggle filter
map.caption: Circle colour shows organisation type and size reflects shared works. Click a legend type to filter, or click a partner to open its profile.
map.unmapped: {count, plural, one {# partner has no coordinates and is not on the map.} other {# partners have no coordinates and are not on the map.}}
map.failed: The map did not load. The table below lists every partner.

summary.line: {partners, plural, one {One partner appears} other {# partners appear}} on {withPartner, plural, one {one} other {#}} of the {works} works that {inst} published from {from} to {to}.
summary.bySource: OpenAlex supplied links for {openalex, plural, one {one work} other {# works}} and OpenAIRE for {openaire, plural, one {one work} other {# works}}.

methodology: How partners are matched, rolled up and counted

detail.dealClosedAlert: {count, plural, one {# shared work was} other {# shared works were}} published closed in a journal covered by a {inst} OA deal. When an external co-author is corresponding author, Dutch deals do not apply — these works are strong candidates for repository deposit (Taverne / Green OA).

merged.title: Included sub-units & former records
merged.description: Entity roll-up combines these same-city sub-units or inactive ROR predecessors into this partner's totals. Open any entry to view its raw ROR record on its own.
